propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope=none must be validated by a new plan-review LLM criterion (no-file-impact) to ensure the assertion is correct and prevent false no-file-impact declarations from silencing drift protection.
The no-file-impact criterion must apply only when persisted scope is exactly 'none'; other values (paths, undeclared, missing, None, unknown) must not trigger LLM evaluation.
The criterion must route deterministically via the applies_at.require_file_impact_scope routing key in criteria_routing.json and a file_impact_scope parameter to registry.applies().
The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON serialization in the Pass-1 request, carrying both non-empty and empty/missing reasons without altering prompt structure.

The criterion produces PASS (external-only deliverables), advisory contradiction (repository-file changes including docs required), or non-blocking coaching (insufficient evidence) based on assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, and repo_file_change_named sub-answers.
